inset.qualification: One planar convex quad inset, baseline preview/cancel, inner face selection into existing Extrude and native persistence.
limits: One regular box in actual Studio; tilted/invalid/mirror-seam fixtures are pure tests. No multi-face regions or wall thickness.

transformRegression.qualification: Baseline numeric world-axis rotation and uniform scale on selected faces, explicit pivot, no-op/cancel/history and native persistence.
limits: One box, two connected top faces, Z rotation and uniform scale in actual Studio. Other axes/mirror/input edge cases are pure tests. No drag/local frame support.
